description: Headerless TV layout: approved absolute resource bars; CPU, memory and disk all eight grid rows high. Half-width RPS and n8n history, three unclipped n8n readouts, two Argo CD state-history lanes. Existing named service tiles and VPN sparkline retained. Fixed 24×16 grid.

panels.description: Firing critical alert instances at the end of the selected period. Click to open the matching rules in Grafana Alerting. The rule list shows current state, even when the dashboard displays a historical period.

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="critical",alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor"}) or (0 * max(up{job="kube-prometheus-stack-prometheus"} == 1))

panels.description: Firing warning alert instances at the end of the selected period. Click to open the matching rules in Grafana Alerting. The rule list shows current state, even when the dashboard displays a historical period.

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="warning",alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor"}) or (0 * max(up{job="kube-prometheus-stack-prometheus"} == 1))

panels.description: VPN execution mode on the VPS. Green K3s means 3xUI is running as the Kubernetes service. Amber Fallback means native systemd mode is latched after Kubernetes stopped serving it. Red Off means the mode metric from socrat-2 is missing or stale, so the VPN host is not reporting a running mode.

targets.expr: max(socrat_vpn_fallback_active{job="node-exporter"} and (time() - timestamp(socrat_vpn_fallback_active{job="node-exporter"}) < 30)) or vector(2)

panels.description: Highest GPU utilization across the collected GPUs. The sample is used only when collection succeeded in the last minute. This is the accelerator on socrat-0, separate from the vLLM service probe.

targets.expr: max(socrat_gpu_utilization_ratio and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))

panels.description: Per-node absolute usage; each bar is normalized to that node’s live capacity, with relative 75% / 90% warning thresholds. CPU shows non-idle logical cores (including iowait), not GHz. Memory is total minus available. Disk is root filesystem size minus free (reserved free blocks are not used). Missing usage/capacity is not replaced with zero.

targets.expr: max by(nodename) (((node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter",mountpoint="/",fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} - node_filesystem_free_bytes{job="node-exporter",mountpoint="/",fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter"}))

max by(nodename) ((node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter",mountpoint="/",fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter"}))

panels.title: Disk

panels.description: Per-node absolute usage; each bar is normalized to that node’s live capacity, with relative 75% / 90% warning thresholds. CPU shows non-idle logical cores (including iowait), not GHz. Memory is total minus available. Disk is root filesystem size minus free (reserved free blocks are not used). targets.expr: max by(nodename) ((sum by(instance)(1 - rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",mode="idle"}[5m]))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter"}))
max by(nodename) ((count by(instance)(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",mode="idle"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter"}))

targets.expr: max by(nodename) (((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter"}))

panels.description: Current Argo Applications, not Pods/history. One equal full block per Application, alphabetically ordered by name; color encodes latest status. Numeric codes1..6 are categorical, not utilization or readiness percentage; max1 intentionally saturates every present block to the same size. Ready=Healthy+Synced, Progressing, Suspended, Git drift=OutOfSync, Unhealthy=Degraded/Missing, Unknown. Latest timestamp wins, priority Unhealthy > Unknown > Progressing > Suspended > drift > Ready. root included so every Argo Application has a block. Hover shows Application name through a native single data link; click opens that Application in Argo CD. Freshness90s and up/inventory completeness guards: unavailable/down/partially stale telemetry produces no data, never green fabricated blocks. Raw sampling15s; dashboard refresh5s. Native Bar gauge solid value-mapped colors, not LCD subdivisions: each whole block corresponds to one Application.
